resources.string: Home trial is on. Choose Stop to end it.

Usage Access lets this trial check app transitions around a Home press. It keeps only the current state in memory and saves no activity history. It needs a fresh transition to the original Home; if Home is already visible, it may stay there. A notification provides Stop. While enabled, it can restart after the TV restarts; if Android stops it during use, choose Start again. Turn it off here or from its notification.
Starting: the observer is calibrating. Start is unavailable until this attempt finishes. Stop cancels it.
Running: the observer is calibrated and ready for a fresh Home transition. Choose Stop to end it.
The saved startup opt-in is on, but the observer is not running. Choose Start to try again or Stop to clear the opt-in.
The observer is off. The last attempt failed (%1$s). Original Home remains available; choose Start to retry after it stops.
Trial is off. Grant Usage Access separately, then choose Start when ready.
